question: Direction: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage and select the most appropriate option for each blank. || Passage: Last Sunday, Ramesh went to the village fair (1) ___ his friends. The fair was crowded, and people were enjoying (2) ___ various rides. There was a huge Ferris wheel in the center, decorated with bright lights. Children were eagerly buying toys and sweets (3) ___ the small stalls. Ramesh decided to (4) ___ a beautifully carved wooden elephant for his little sister. After spending hours at the fair, they returned home feeling very (5) ___ and tired. || Question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 1.
explanation: Ramesh apne doston ke 'saath' fair gaya tha. Sang ya saath darshane ke liye preposition 'with' ka use hota hai.
trick: Jab bhi kisi vyakti ke saath hone ka sense aaye, wahan 'with' lagana sabse safe hota hai.
tip: 'With' ka matlab kisi ke 'saath' hona hota hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 1, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 2.
explanation: Yahan specific rides ki baat ho rahi hai jo mele mein the, isliye definite article 'the' aayega. 'Various rides' plural hai, isliye 'a' ya 'an' nahi aa sakta.
trick: Noun (rides) plural hai aur 'a/an' hamesha singular ke sath aata hai, isliye 'the' right choice hai.
tip: Specific aur plural noun ke pehle 'the' lagta hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 1, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 3.
explanation: Bachche stalls 'se' khilone khareed rahe the. Jab hum kisi source se kuch lete hain, toh wahan 'from' use hota hai.
trick: 'Buying something ___ a place' ke structure mein source dikhane ke liye 'from' aata hai.
tip: Source ya origin batane ke liye 'from' lagayein.

question: Based on the passage in Question 1, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 4.
explanation: Blank ke theek pehle 'to' laga hai. English grammar mein 'to' ke baad hamesha verb ki first form (infinitive) aati hai.
trick: To + V1 ka rule hamesha yaad rakhein. 'To' dekhte hi base form of verb dhoondhein.
tip: 'To' ke baad hamesha verb ki V1 form aati hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 1, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 5.
explanation: Mela ghoomna ek positive anubhav hai. Unhone bahut enjoy kiya, isliye thakne ke bawajood wo khush (happy) the.
trick: Passage ka tone positive hai, isliye options mein se positive word (happy) chunein. Baaki sab negative words hain.
tip: Sentence ka mood aur tone samajh kar word chunein.

question: Direction: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage and select the most appropriate option for each blank. || Passage: Once upon a time, there lived a poor woodcutter. Every day, he went into the forest to chop wood. One afternoon, while he was cutting a tree near a river, his axe slipped (6) ___ his hands and fell into the deep water. He started crying because he had no money to buy (7) ___ axe. Suddenly, a river fairy appeared and asked him why he was (8) ___. The woodcutter explained his problem. The fairy dived into the water and brought out a golden axe. She asked if it was his. The honest woodcutter refused to (9) ___ it. Pleased by his honesty, the fairy gave him (10) ___ the axes as a reward. || Question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 6.
explanation: Kulhadi uske haathon 'se' phisal gayi. Jab koi cheez alag hoti hai (separation), toh 'from' preposition ka prayog karte hain.
trick: 'Slipped' ke sath separation dikhane ke liye 'from' hi best fit hota hai.
tip: Alag hone (separation) ke sense mein 'from' use karein.

question: Based on the passage in Question 6, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 7.
explanation: Uski kulhadi gir gayi thi aur use ab 'ek aur' (doosri) kulhadi chahiye thi. Singular countable noun ke sath 'another' lagta hai.
trick: 'Axe' singular hai. 'Few' aur 'many' plural ke sath aate hain. Bacha 'another' jo yahan perfect hai.
tip: 'Another' ka matlab ek aur (doosra) hota hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 6, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 8.
explanation: Pichle sentence mein clearly likha hai 'He started crying', isliye fairy ne aakar us se rone ka hi karan poocha hoga.
trick: Aise blanks ka answer hamesha unke theek pehle ya baad wale sentence mein chhupa hota hai.
tip: Pichle sentence ko padh kar context ka hint lein.

question: Based on the passage in Question 6, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 9.
explanation: Woodcutter emandaar tha, isliye usne sone ki kulhadi sweekar karne (accept) se mana kar diya (refused).
trick: Refuse (mana karna) ke baad hum wahi action lagate hain jo lalach dikhata ho, yaani 'accept' karna.
tip: 'Accept' ka matlab sweekar karna ya lena hota hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 6, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 10.
explanation: Pari uski emandaari se bahut khush hui aur inaam ke roop mein use 'saari' (all) kulhadiyan de di.
trick: Blank ke baad 'the axes' (plural) hai. 'Each' aur 'every' hamesha singular noun lete hain, isliye 'all' aayega.
tip: Plural noun se pehle 'all' ka use ekdum sahi hai.

question: Direction: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage and select the most appropriate option for each blank. || Passage: Travelling by train in India is always a fascinating experience. We reached the railway station an hour (11) ___ the scheduled departure. The platform was bustling with passengers, coolies, and vendors. We quickly found our coach and settled into our seats. As the train started to move, the cool breeze came through the (12) ___. Vendors walked up and down the aisle selling hot tea and snacks. My father bought some samosas (13) ___ everyone. Looking out, we saw lush green fields and small villages passing (14) ___. The rhythmic sound of the wheels on the tracks soon made me feel (15) ___. || Question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 11.
explanation: Train chhootne ke ek ghanta 'pehle' station pahuchne ki baat ho rahi hai. Samay se pehle ke liye 'before' aata hai.
trick: 'Departure' se pehle hi station pahucha jata hai travel karne ke liye, toh logic ke hisaab se 'before' aayega.
tip: Samay ke pehle ke liye 'before' use karein.

question: Based on the passage in Question 11, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 12.
explanation: Train chalne par thandi hawa (cool breeze) khidki (window) ke raste se hi andar aati hai.
trick: Common sense lagayein, passengers train ke andar hote hain toh hawa roof ya engine se nahi, window se aayegi.
tip: Breeze (hawa) hamesha window se feel hoti hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 11, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 13.
explanation: Pitaji ne sabke 'liye' samose khareede. Jab kisi ke fayde ya purpose ke liye kuch kiya jaye toh 'for' lagate hain.
trick: 'Bought something ___ someone' wale sentences mein hamesha 'for' ka hi istemaal hota hai.
tip: 'For' ka istemaal 'ke liye' ke arth mein hota hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 11, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 14.
explanation: Jab train aage badhti hai toh khet aur gaon peeche chhutate hain. Bagal se guzarne ko English mein 'passing by' kehte hain.
trick: 'Pass by' ek common phrasal verb hai jiska matlab kisi ke paas se guzar jana hota hai.
tip: Kahin se guzarne ke liye 'pass by' phrasal verb yaad rakhein.

question: Based on the passage in Question 11, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 15.
explanation: Train ke pahiyon ki lagataar awaaz (rhythmic sound) sunkar nind aane lagi thi (sleepy feel hona).
trick: Awaaz ka rhythmic pattern insaan ko relax karta hai, jisse neend (sleepy) aati hai. Active ya angry illogical hoga.
tip: Sleepy ek adjective hai jiska matlab nind aana hai.

question: Direction: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. question: Based on the passage in Question 16, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 17.

question: Based on the passage in Question 16, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 18.
explanation: Kisi cheez ko dhoondhne ke liye English mein 'look for' phrasal verb ka use kiya jata hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 16, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 19.
explanation: Library ki kitabein ek nishchit samay par wapas karni hoti hain. Sahi samay par kaam karne ko 'on time' kehte hain.
trick: Jab time strict ho aur ussi par kaam karna ho, toh hamesha 'on time' phrase ka use karein.
tip: Fixed samay par kaam ke liye 'on time' bolte hain.

question: Based on the passage in Question 16, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 20.
explanation: Agar aap library ki book kharab kar dein ya guma dein, toh rule todne ki wajah se jurmana (fine) lagta hai.

question: Direction: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage and select the most appropriate option for each blank. || Passage: Diwali is the festival of lights and is celebrated with great enthusiasm all (1) ___ India. question: Based on the passage in Question 21, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 2.

question: Based on the passage in Question 21, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 3.

trick: Blank ke pehle 'and' hai. 'Wealth' ek positive word hai, isliye 'and' ke baad bhi positive word (prosperity) aayega.
tip: 'Prosperity' ka matlab samriddhi ya sampannata hota hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 21, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 4.
explanation: 'Opt for' ek phrasal verb hai jiska matlab kisi cheez ko chunna (choose karna) hota hai.
trick: Jab bhi 'opting' ya 'opt' word dikhe, uske sath hamesha 'for' preposition hi lagaya jata hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 21, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 5.

trick: Yahan 'joy and ___' likha hai. Joy ek positive feeling hai, toh blank mein bhi positive feeling (happiness) aayegi.

question: Direction: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Construction of the Taj Mahal took around twenty-two years to (3) ___, with thousands of artisans working day and night. Today, it attracts millions of tourists (4) ___ year who come to admire its beauty. It is truly a symbol of eternal (5) ___. || Question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 1.
explanation: Yeh sentence passive voice mein hai ('was built'). Jab batana ho ki kaam kisne kiya, toh 'by' lagate hain.
trick: Passive voice ('was/were' + V3) ke baad subject (jiska kaam hai) batane ke liye hamesha 'by' aata hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 26, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 2.

question: Based on the passage in Question 26, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 3.
explanation: Blank ke pehle 'to' laga hai. English grammar ke anusar 'to' ke baad verb ki pehli form (V1) aati hai.
trick: To + V1 (infinitive) rule yaad rakhein. Options mein se base form 'complete' hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 26, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 4.

trick: 'Year' singular hai. 'All', 'some', aur 'many' ke baad plural noun aana chahiye (jaise years). Bacha 'every'.

question: Based on the passage in Question 26, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 5.

tip: 'Eternal' ka matlab hamesha rehne wala (amar) hota hai.

question: Direction: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage and select the most appropriate option for each blank. || Passage: One hot summer day, a thirsty crow was flying in search of water. After a long time, he saw a pitcher lying (1) ___ the ground. He flew down to drink water, but the water level was too (2) ___ for his beak to reach. The crow tried to push the pitcher, but it was too heavy. Suddenly, he saw some pebbles scattered (3) ___ the pitcher. He picked up the pebbles one by one and dropped them (4) ___ the pitcher. Slowly, the water level rose up, and the clever crow drank the water happily before flying (5) ___. || Question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 1.
explanation: Ghada zameen (ground) 'par' pada tha. Jab koi cheez kisi surface ko touch karti hai, toh 'on' lagate hain.
trick: Zameen (ground) ek flat surface hai, aur surface ke upper touch karte hue rakhne par hamesha 'on' aata hai.
tip: Surface par rakhi cheez ke liye 'on' use karein.

question: Based on the passage in Question 31, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 2.

trick: Agar chonch (beak) nahi pahunch rahi, iska matlab paani kam tha aur level 'low' tha.

question: Based on the passage in Question 31, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 3.

trick: Agar kankar 'far' hote toh wo jaldi na la pata. 'Inside' hote toh uski problem wahi solve ho jati. 'Near' logical hai.
tip: 'Near' ka matlab hota hai paas ya nikat.

question: Based on the passage in Question 31, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 4.
explanation: Kauwe ne kankar uthaye aur ghade ke 'andar' daale. Jab motion (gati) ke sath andar jate hain, toh 'into' lagta hai.
trick: Bahar se andar ki taraf movement dikhane wale actions (jaise dropped, threw, jumped) ke sath hamesha 'into' aata hai.
tip: Gati karke andar jane par 'into' ka prayog hota hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 31, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 5.
explanation: Paani peekar kauwa ud gaya. Ud kar door jane ko 'fly away' kaha jata hai.
trick: Panchiyon ka ek jagah se udkar door jana English mein 'flying away' kahlata hai.
tip: 'Fly away' ek phrasal verb hai jiska arth ud jana hai.

question: Direction: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage and select the most appropriate option for each blank. || Passage: Going for a morning walk is an excellent way to start the day. Many people prefer to jog or do yoga on the lush green grass. Doctors often advise older adults to walk daily to maintain their fitness and keep diseases at (3) ___. Regular walking not only strengthens the body but also brings (4) ___ to the mind. Therefore, we should make it a (5) ___ to wake up early and go for a walk. || Question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 1.
explanation: Subah ki tazi hawa hamari sehat 'ke liye' faydemand (beneficial) hoti hai. Yahan 'ke liye' ka sense hai.
trick: Jab bhi 'beneficial' word use hota hai, uske theek baad preposition 'for' ya 'to' lagta hai, yahan 'for our health' better flow karta hai.
tip: 'Beneficial for' ka matlab hota hai kisi ke liye faydemand.

question: Based on the passage in Question 36, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 2.

trick: Birds baithne ke liye pedon ki daaliyan chunte hain, isliye 'roots' (jadein) ya 'soil' (mitti) galat honge.

question: Based on the passage in Question 36, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 3.
explanation: 'Keep at bay' ek fixed idiom hai jiska matlab hota hai kisi buri cheez (jaise bimari) ko door rakhna.
trick: Yeh ek famous muhavara hai. 'Keep ___ at bay' padhte hi 'bay' option tick kar dena chahiye.
tip: 'Keep at bay' ka arth door rakhna ya bachna hota hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 36, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 4.
explanation: Walking ek acchi exercise hai, isse dimaag ko shanti (peace) milti hai. Baaki sab negative options hain.
trick: Sentence mein 'not only... but also' ka rule hai. Agar 'strengthens' positive hai, toh mind ko bhi 'peace' jaisi positive cheez milegi.

question: Based on the passage in Question 36, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 5.
explanation: Humein subah jaldi uthne aur walk par jane ko apni aadat (habit) bana lena chahiye.
trick: Rozana kiye jane wale acche kaamo ko English mein 'habit' (aadat) kehte hain. Baki words ka arth galat hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 41, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 4.

question: Based on the passage in Question 41, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 5.

question: Direction: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. question: Based on the passage in Question 46, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 2.

question: Based on the passage in Question 46, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 3.

question: Based on the passage in Question 46, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 4.

question: Based on the passage in Question 46, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 5.

trick: Jab bhi kisi cheez ke roop mein inaam milta hai (jaise medal), toh hamesha 'rewarded with' ka use karein.

question: Direction: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage and select the most appropriate option for each blank. || Passage: Emperor Ashoka was one of the greatest rulers in Indian history. Initially, he was known as a fierce warrior who conquered many lands. However, the bloody Kalinga War completely changed his (1) ___. Seeing the death and destruction on the battlefield, he felt deep sorrow. He decided to give up violence and embraced Buddhism. Ashoka spent the rest of his life spreading the message of (2) ___ and non-violence. He built hospitals for humans and animals, and planted trees (3) ___ the roads. His teachings were carved on rocks and pillars, which can still be seen (4) ___ different parts of the country. He ruled his empire just (5) ___ a father cares for his children. || Question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 1.
explanation: Kalinga yuddh ke bloodshed ne Ashoka ka hriday (heart) parivartit kar diya tha. Yeh ek common historical fact hai.
trick: Insan ka nature aur soch badalne ko 'change of heart' kaha jata hai. Clothes ya weapons ka badalna logical nahi hai.
tip: 'Changed his heart' ka matlab soch/vichaar badalna hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 51, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 2.
explanation: Buddhism apnane ke baad Ashoka ne shanti (peace) aur ahimsa (non-violence) ka sandesh failaya.
trick: Blank ke aage 'and non-violence' likha hai. 'Peace' aur 'non-violence' (shanti aur ahimsa) hamesha sath aate hain.
tip: Positive aur ahinsak soch ke sath 'peace' judta hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 51, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 3.
explanation: Usne sadkon ke kinare (along) ped lagwaye. Jab koi cheez kisi lambaai ke parallel hoti hai, tab 'along' lagate hain.
trick: Sadak (road) ya nadi (river) ke kinare-kinare hone ke sense mein hamesha 'along' preposition aata hai.
tip: Sadak ke kinare-kinare ke liye 'along the roads' use karein.

question: Based on the passage in Question 51, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 4.
explanation: Desh ke vibhinn hisson 'mein' yeh pillars dekhe ja sakte hain. Badi jagah ya parts ke liye 'in' ka prayog hota hai.
trick: Jab bhi 'parts of the country/world' jaisa phrase aaye, uske pehle humesha 'in' preposition lagta hai.
tip: Vibhinn hisson 'mein' ke arth ke liye 'in' lagayein.

question: Based on the passage in Question 51, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 5.
explanation: Usne rajya par aise shasan kiya 'jaise' (like) ek pita apne bachchon ki dekhbhal karta hai.
trick: Jab do alag-alag situations ko compare karte hain ('jaise ki'), wahan 'like' ka use sabse simple aur correct hota hai.
tip: Tulna (comparison) karne ke liye 'like' ka prayog karein.

question: Direction: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage and select the most appropriate option for each blank. || Passage: Water is essential for the survival of all living beings on Earth. Without water, life (1) ___ not exist. We use water for various daily activities like drinking, cooking, and washing. However, the amount of fresh water available on our planet is very (2) ___. Unfortunately, many people waste water carelessly. Industrial pollution is also contaminating our rivers and lakes. If we do not take immediate steps to (3) ___ water, future generations will face severe shortages. We must fix leaking taps and avoid keeping the water running while brushing our (4) ___. Every single drop counts, so let us pledge to use water (5) ___. || Question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 1.
explanation: Paani ke bina jeevan astitva mein nahi reh sakta (cannot exist). Yahan possibility/ability ki baat ho rahi hai.
trick: Satta/sakna (ability/possibility) dikhane ke liye 'can' ka use hota hai. Yahan 'can not' sahi baithta hai.
tip: 'Can' ka arth hai 'sakna' ya sambhavana hona.

question: Based on the passage in Question 56, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 2.
explanation: Dharti par peene yogya saaf paani ki matra bahut seemit (limited) hai, isliye hume ise bachana chahiye.
trick: Agla sentence keh raha hai ki log paani barbaad kar rahe hain aur shortage (kami) hogi. Iska matlab paani 'limited' hai.
tip: Saaf paani ki matra seemit (limited) hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 56, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 3.
explanation: Bhavishya mein paani ki kami se bachne ke liye humein ise sanrakshit (conserve) karne ke kadam uthane honge.
trick: Problem water shortage ki hai, toh step usko 'save' ya 'conserve' karne ka hi hoga. Waste aur pollute negative hain.
tip: 'Conserve' ka matlab sanrakshan karna ya bachana hota hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 56, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 4.
explanation: Daant saaf karte (brushing) samay nal khula nahi chhodna chahiye. Brush karne ke sath 'teeth' hi aata hai.
trick: Common daily routine ki baat hai. 'Brushing' word ke baad turant 'teeth' dimaag mein aana chahiye.
tip: 'Brushing our teeth' ek common daily activity hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 56, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 5.
explanation: Har ek boond keemti hai, isliye humein shapat leni chahiye ki hum paani ka upyog samajhdari se (wisely) karenge.
trick: Passage paani bachane ki advice de raha hai. Ek samajhdari wale kam ke liye adverb 'wisely' sabse best hai.
tip: 'Wisely' ka matlab hota hai samajhdari se.

question: Direction: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage and select the most appropriate option for each blank. || Passage: Mohan lived in a small village. He had always dreamed of visiting a big city. One day, his uncle invited him to spend his summer holidays (1) ___ Mumbai. Mohan was extremely (2) ___ to see the tall buildings and crowded streets. On his first day, they went to a famous museum. There, Mohan saw many ancient artifacts kept (3) ___ glass cases. Later, they travelled by a local train, which was full (4) ___ people rushing to their offices. Despite the noise and rush, Mohan enjoyed the city life and returned home with unforgettable (5) ___. || Question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 1.
explanation: Bade shehron (jaise Mumbai, Delhi) ke naam se pehle hamesha preposition 'in' ka prayog kiya jata hai.
trick: City ya country ka naam dekhte hi uske aage 'in' lagayein.
tip: Bade sthanon ke liye 'in' preposition use hota hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 61, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 2.
explanation: Mohan ka pehli baar kisi bade shehar mein aana aur unchi buildings dekhna uske andar utsaah (excitement) paida karega.
trick: Blank ke baad 'to see the tall buildings' likha hai. Nayi cheez dekh kar log excited hote hain, sad ya bored nahi.
tip: Naye experience ke liye 'excited' (utsahit) sahi shabd hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 61, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 3.
explanation: Museum mein purani cheezein kaanch ke box (glass cases) ke 'andar' rakhi jati hain taaki wo surakshit rahein.
trick: Jab koi cheez kisi band dabbe ya case ke andar ho, to wahan 'inside' ka use sabse accha hota hai.
tip: Kisi band jagah ke andar ke liye 'inside' lagayein.

question: Based on the passage in Question 61, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 4.
explanation: 'Full of' ek fixed phrase hai jiska matlab hota hai kisi cheez se poori tarah bhara hua hona. Train logon se bhari thi.
trick: Jab bhi 'full' word ke baad blank aaye aur kisi cheez se bhara hone ka sense ho, to hamesha 'of' lagayein.
tip: 'Full of' ka arth hai poori tarah bhara hua.

question: Based on the passage in Question 61, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 5.
explanation: Mohan ne trip ko enjoy kiya aur ghar wapas lauta, to zahir hai wo apne sath achhi yaadein (memories) laya hoga.
trick: 'Unforgettable' (na bhoolne yogya) ke sath hamesha 'memories' word ka hi combination sabse common hota hai.
tip: Achhi trip se hamesha 'memories' (yaadein) milti hain.

question: Direction: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage and select the most appropriate option for each blank. || Passage: Good health is the most valuable asset a person can have. To stay healthy, one must eat a balanced diet and drink plenty of (1) ___. Regular exercise is also essential for maintaining a fit body. Walking, jogging, and swimming are some of the best ways to keep yourself (2) ___. Unfortunately, in today's fast-paced world, many people consume junk food which is harmful (3) ___ their health. Lack of physical activity leads to obesity and various other diseases. Therefore, we should make it a priority to take out time (4) ___ our busy schedules for exercise. A healthy body houses a (5) ___ mind. || Question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 1.
explanation: Sehatmand rehne ke liye balanced diet ke sath khoob sara paani (water) peena zaroori hota hai.
trick: Diet aur health ki baat ho rahi hai. Health ke liye oil, salt ya sugar nahi, balki water sabse zyada faydemand hai.
tip: Healthy rehne ke liye plenty of 'water' zaroori hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 66, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 2.
explanation: Exercise (walking, swimming) karne se hamara sharir chust aur phurtila (active) rehta hai.
trick: Exercise ke fayde ki baat ho rahi hai, isliye negative words jaise lazy, sleepy aur tired galat hain.
tip: Exercise humein hamesha 'active' rakhti hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 66, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 3.
explanation: Junk food health ke liye nuksan-dayak (harmful) hota hai. English grammar mein 'harmful' ke baad hamesha 'to' preposition aata hai.
trick: 'Harmful to' ek fixed prepositional pair hai. Isko directly yaad kar lena chahiye.
tip: Hamesha yaad rakhein: 'Harmful to' (nuksandayak).

question: Based on the passage in Question 66, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 4.
explanation: Humein apne vyast schedule 'se' thoda samay nikalna chahiye. Kisi cheez mein se hissa alag karne ke liye 'from' lagta hai.
trick: Samay 'nikalne' ki baat ho rahi hai (take out time), jab origin ya source se kuch nikalte hain to 'from' aata hai.
tip: Kisi routine ya schedule 'se' ke liye 'from' lagayein.

question: Based on the passage in Question 66, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 5.
explanation: Ek swasth sharir (healthy body) mein hi ek swasth dimaag (healthy mind) ka nivas hota hai. Yeh ek mashhoor kahawat hai.
trick: Proverb ko yaad karein: 'A sound/healthy mind in a sound/healthy body'. Isliye yahan 'healthy' aayega.
tip: Healthy body mein hamesha 'healthy' mind hota hai.

question: Direction: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage and select the most appropriate option for each blank. || Passage: The invention of the wheel is considered one of the greatest achievements of early humans. Before the wheel was invented, people had to carry heavy loads (1) ___ their backs or use animals. The earliest wheels were made by cutting solid blocks (2) ___ wood. Gradually, humans learned to make lighter wheels with spokes. This incredible invention completely changed the way people travelled and transported goods. Carts pulled by horses or oxen became very (3) ___. Later, the wheel was also used in making pottery and spinning yarn. It is hard to imagine our modern world (4) ___ the wheel, as it is used in almost every machine (5) ___. || Question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 1.
explanation: Pahiye ke aavishkar se pehle log bhari saman apni peeth 'par' (on their backs) uthate the.
trick: Body part par koi cheez rakhne ya dhone ke sense mein 'on' preposition ka use hota hai.
tip: Peeth (back) par saman rakhne ke liye 'on' lagayein.

question: Based on the passage in Question 71, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 2.
explanation: Shuruati pahiye lakdi 'ke' thos tukdon (blocks of wood) se banaye jate the. Sambandh darshane ke liye 'of' aata hai.
trick: Jab koi cheez kisi material se bani ho aur uski state change na ho, wahan 'blocks of wood' wala structure 'of' leta hai.
tip: 'Blocks of wood' ka arth lakdi ke tukde hota hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 71, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 3.
explanation: Pahiye ke aane ke baad ghode aur bail gaadiyan bahut aam (common) ho gayin, kyunki safar asaan ho gaya tha.
trick: Invention ke baad cheezein logo tak aasaani se pahuchti hain, isliye wo 'common' ho jati hain. Rare ya unknown galat hoga.
tip: 'Common' ka matlab jo aam taur par dekhi jaye.

question: Based on the passage in Question 71, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 4.
explanation: Pahiye ke bina (without) aaj ke aadhunik duniya ki kalpana karna mushkil hai.
trick: Sentence ka arth samjhein. Pahiya itna zaroori hai ki uske 'bina' (without) duniya aage nahi badh sakti.
tip: 'Without' ka arth kisi cheez ke bina hota hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 71, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 5.
explanation: Yahan current modern world ki baat ho rahi hai. 'Aaj' ke samay mein lagbhag har machine mein wheel ka use hota hai.
trick: Passage mein 'modern world' aur present tense ('is used') ka zikr hai, isliye past ya future nahi, balki present 'today' aayega.
tip: Present time dikhane ke liye 'today' ka use karein.

question: Direction: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage and select the most appropriate option for each blank. || Passage: Once, there was a hardworking farmer who had a large piece of land. Every year, he worked tirelessly from morning (1) ___ evening to grow his crops. One year, there was no rainfall, and a severe drought hit the village. The farmer was worried because his crops were drying (2) ___. However, he did not lose hope. He remembered an old well situated at the corner of his field. He dug the well deeper until he finally found (3) ___. Using a simple pulley system, he managed to irrigate his entire field. His hard work paid off, and he had a bountiful (4) ___ that year. His neighbors praised him for his determination and (5) ___. || Question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 1.
explanation: Kisan subah se shaam tak (from morning to evening) kadi mehnat karta tha. 'From' ke sath 'to' ka pair banta hai.
trick: English grammar mein 'from... to...' ek pakka joda (correlative structure) hai. 'From' dekhte hi 'to' dhoondhein.
tip: Samay ke interval ke liye 'From ... to ...' lagayein.

question: Based on the passage in Question 76, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 2.
explanation: Bina baarish ke fasal sookh rahi thi. Poori tarah sookhne ko English mein phrasal verb 'dry up' kehte hain.
trick: Pani ki kami se jab koi cheez murjha ya sookh jati hai, to uske liye 'dry' ke sath hamesha 'up' lagta hai.
tip: 'Dry up' ka matlab poori tarah sookh jana hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 76, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 3.
explanation: Kisan ne apne khet ke ek purane kuen (well) ko gehra khoda jisme use aakhirkar pani (water) mil gaya.
trick: Drought (sookha) padne par kisan fasal ko bachane ke liye kuen se sirf pani (water) hi nikalega. Gold ya oil nahi.
tip: Kuen (well) ko pani (water) ke liye khoda jata hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 76, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 4.
explanation: Kisan ki mehnat rang layi aur us saal uski fasal ki paidaawar (harvest) bahut acchi hui.
trick: Blank se pehle 'bountiful' (prachur/shandaar) aur 'hard work paid off' likha hai, isliye answer positive word 'harvest' hoga.
tip: 'Harvest' ka arth fasal ki katai ya paidaawar hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 76, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 5.
explanation: Padosiyon ne kisan ke dridh nishchay aur uski samajhdari/buddhimani (wisdom) ki tareef ki, kyunki usne mushkil mein rasta nikala.
trick: 'Praise' (tareef karna) humesha achhi baaton par hota hai. Options mein sirf 'wisdom' (samajhdari) hi positive word hai.
tip: 'Wisdom' ka matlab samajhdari ya buddhimani hota hai.

question: Direction: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage and select the most appropriate option for each blank. || Passage: Ramu is a dedicated postman who works (1) ___ the local post office. He delivers letters and parcels (2) ___ the village people. Rain or shine, he never misses a day of work. One day, he found a wallet lying (3) ___ the road. He looked inside and found some money and an ID card. He immediately went to the address mentioned on the card and returned the wallet (4) ___ its owner. The owner was extremely grateful and offered Ramu a reward, but Ramu politely refused, saying it was his (5) ___. || Question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 1.
explanation: Kisi specific jagah ya workplace (jaise post office, bank) par kaam karne ke liye 'at' preposition ka use hota hai.
trick: 'Works ___ a specific place' ke structure mein hamesha 'at' lagayein. Yahan local post office fixed jagah hai.
tip: Specific sthan darshane ke liye 'at' ka prayog karein.

question: Based on the passage in Question 81, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 2.
explanation: Kisi ko kuch dena ya pahunchana (deliver) ho, toh destination ya receiver se pehle 'to' lagta hai.
trick: Deliver action ke baad jab kisi insaan (receiver) ka naam aaye, toh theek pehle 'to' aata hai.
tip: Kisi tak cheez pahunchane ke disha mein 'to' lagta hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 81, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 3.
explanation: Wallet sadak ki satah (surface) par pada tha. Kisi satah ko touch karke rakhne par 'on' lagate hain.
trick: Road ek flat surface hai. Zameen ya sadak ke upar hone ke liye humesha 'on the road' bolte hain.
tip: Satah (surface) par rakhi cheez ke liye 'on' aata hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 81, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 4.
explanation: Lautana (return) ek action hai jisme cheez owner ke paas wapas ja rahi hai. Receiver batane ke liye 'to' aayega.
trick: 'Return something ___ someone' wale structure mein direction dikhane ke liye hamesha 'to' lagta hai.
tip: Wapas lautane ki disha batane ke liye 'to' lagayein.

question: Based on the passage in Question 81, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 5.
explanation: Postman ne apni imandari dikhayi aur usne reward lene se mana kar diya kyunki ye uska kartavya (duty) tha.
trick: Context positive aur imandari ka hai, isliye options mein se mistake ya fault nahi balki 'duty' chunein.
tip: Kartavya ko English mein 'duty' kehte hain.

question: Direction: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage and select the most appropriate option for each blank. || Passage: The Great Wall of China is one of the (1) ___ wonders of the world. It was built centuries ago to protect the Chinese Empire (2) ___ invading enemies. The wall is made of stone, brick, and other sturdy materials. It stretches (3) ___ thousands of miles. Many emperors contributed to its construction. Today, it is a popular tourist destination, attracting millions of visitors (4) ___ year. Walking along the wall gives people a sense of the immense skill and (5) ___ work of the ancient builders. || Question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 1.
explanation: 'One of the' ke baad hamesha adjective ki superlative degree ka use hota hai, isliye 'greatest' aayega.
trick: Blank se pehle 'the' article laga hai, jo clearly ishara kar raha hai ki superlative degree (greatest) aayegi.
tip: 'One of the' ke baad superlative degree lagayein.

question: Based on the passage in Question 86, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 2.
explanation: Kisi khatre ya dushman se bachane (protect) ke context mein hamesha 'from' preposition ka prayog hota hai.
trick: 'Protect someone ___ danger' wale sentence mein seedha 'from' lagana chahiye.
tip: Bachav (protection) ka srot batane ke liye 'from' lagayein.

question: Based on the passage in Question 86, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 3.
explanation: Jab koi cheez ek bahut lambe hisse (thousands of miles) mein phaili ho, toh uske liye 'across' ka use hota hai.
trick: Duri ya lamba area cover karne ke sense mein 'stretches across' ek bahut common phrasal construction hai.
tip: Lambi duri mein phailne ko 'across' kehte hain.

question: Based on the passage in Question 86, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 4.
explanation: 'Year' ek singular noun hai, iska matlab hai har saal. Singular noun ke sath 'every' bilkul sahi hai.
trick: 'All', 'some', aur 'few' ke baad hamesha plural noun (years) aana chahiye, isliye akele bache 'every' ko tick karein.
tip: Singular countable noun ke pehle 'every' aata hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 86, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 5.
explanation: Deewar banane wale prachin logon ne bahut mehnat ki thi, aur kadi mehnat ko angrezi mein 'hard work' kehte hain.
trick: Passage builders ki taareef kar raha hai, toh yahan positive aur strong adjective 'hard' (work) hi aayega.
tip: Kadi mehnat ko English mein 'hard work' bolte hain.

question: Direction: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage and select the most appropriate option for each blank. || Passage: Yesterday evening, my mother asked me to go to the market to buy some fresh (1) ___. I took a cloth bag and walked towards the busy street. The market was very crowded, and vendors were shouting (2) ___ the top of their voices to attract customers. I went to a stall and asked for two kilos of potatoes. The shopkeeper weighed the potatoes and put them (3) ___ my bag. After that, I bought some apples and bananas. While returning home, it suddenly started raining (4) ___. I had to run to find some shelter to save myself from getting (5) ___. || Question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 1.
explanation: Market se hum tazi (fresh) sabziyan (vegetables) khareedte hain, fresh kapde ya joote nahi hote.
trick: 'Fresh' word aam taur par khane-peene ki cheezon ke sath aata hai, isliye 'vegetables' sabse best option hai.
tip: 'Fresh' word khane ki cheezon ke liye use hota hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 91, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 2.
explanation: Zor se chillane ko angrezi mein 'at the top of one's voice' kaha jata hai. Yeh ek fixed phrase hai.
trick: Jab bhi 'the top of' likha dikhe, aam taur par uske theek pehle 'at' preposition hi aata hai.
tip: 'At the top of' ek common angrezi muhavara hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 91, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 3.
explanation: Shopkeeper ne aaloo ko tola aur bag ke 'andar' daala. Jab koi cheez motion ke sath andar jati hai, toh 'into' lagta hai.
trick: Gati (motion) darshane wale actions mein 'in' ki jagah 'into' preposition use hota hai.
tip: Gati karke andar aane ko 'into' kehte hain.

question: Based on the passage in Question 91, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 4.
explanation: Tez baarish hone ko describe karne ke liye hamesha adverb 'heavily' ka use kiya jata hai.
trick: Baarish (rain) ki tivrata ko batane ke liye 'heavy' word ka hi prayog hota hai, isliye 'heavily' right hai.
tip: Zor ki baarish ko 'raining heavily' bolte hain.

question: Based on the passage in Question 91, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 5.
explanation: Lekhak ne baarish se bachne ke liye chhanv (shelter) dhoondhi taaki wo bheeg (wet) na jaye.
trick: Baarish (rain) aur chhatri ya shelter ka context seedhe roop se paani se bheegne (getting wet) se juda hai.
tip: 'Get wet' ka matlab baarish mein bheeg jana hota hai.

question: Direction: In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage and select the most appropriate option for each blank. || Passage: During a bright and warm summer, a grasshopper was hopping about, chirping and singing to its heart's (1) ___. An ant passed by, carrying an ear of corn with great effort to its nest. The grasshopper invited the ant to chat and play, instead of (2) ___ so hard. The ant replied that it was storing food for the winter and advised the grasshopper to do the (3) ___. The grasshopper laughed and said that winter was far away. But when winter came, the grasshopper found itself dying of (4) ___, while it saw the ants sharing the food they had stored. Then the grasshopper finally (5) ___ its mistake. || Question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 1.
explanation: 'To one's heart's content' ek idiom hai jiska arth hai jab tak man na bhar jaye tab tak khush rehna ya enjoy karna.
trick: Story mein grasshopper khush hai, isliye negative words (sorrow, fear) nikal dein. 'Content' (santhushti) sahi answer hai.
tip: Jee bhar ke enjoy karne ko 'to heart's content' bolte hain.

question: Based on the passage in Question 96, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 2.
explanation: Cheenti apne khane ko le jane mein bohot kadi mehnat (working hard) kar rahi thi, isliye yahan 'working' aayega.
trick: Ant bojh utha kar mehnat kar rahi hai. Mehnat ko English mein work kehte hain, toh 'working' right option hoga.
tip: 'Instead of' ke baad hamesha V4 (ing form) aata hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 96, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 3.
explanation: Cheenti apna khana sardiyon ke liye jama kar rahi thi aur usne grasshopper ko bhi waisa hi (same) karne ki salah di.
trick: Jab hum kisi ko apne jaisa kaam karne ko kehte hain, toh humesha 'do the same' phrase ka use kiya jata hai.
tip: Waisa hi kaam karne ko 'do the same' kehte hain.

question: Based on the passage in Question 96, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 4.
